refusals.reason: The only real-world form the record's own note points to, 'Abbott Rapid Diagnostics Ltd', is a SEPARATE supplier record in this seed (Abbott Rapid Diagnostics). refusals.name: Accrington Surgical
refusals.reason: accringtonsurgical.co.uk is the company's own site and its page title is "Accrington Surgical Instrument Suppliers LTD"; its own news page carries "NHS Supply Chain Surgical Instruments Framework Award", the same framework this record was created from. So the only real-world longer form of this name is "Accrington Surgical Instrument Suppliers Ltd", which is a SEPARATE record's own name in this seed. Recording it here would trip verify.py's alias_steals_name hard fail and hand this record every lookup meant for that one. Companies House holds ACCRINGTON SURGICAL LTD (06046644) but it is DISSOLVED, so it cannot be the current supplier either. Needs Lou's call on merging the three Accrington records. Speciality "Theatres / surgical" WAS added, from the company's own product pages.
